events.title: The base-station requirement baseline
events.summary: The earlier PRD defines the base station's electrical and mechanical requirements, including operating-test conditions that recur in the later test-definition work. Credit: NOON / Locoroll.

events.title: A guide proposed for the air-gap mechanism

events.title: Retention and locating features separated
events.summary: Function Engineering's four-hook analysis identifies competing locating surfaces and proposes controlled bearing features with clearance elsewhere. Credit: Function Engineering.

events.summary: Erik's edit makes methods, limits and durations explicit in tables left blank in the May version. The same operating conditions were already present in the earlier requirement baseline; some fields remained open. Credit: Erik Norris.

events.title: Supplier file identities tied to the assembly structure
events.summary: The naming guide connects CAD filenames and drawing titles to Arena item identities and requires assemblies to follow the BOM structure. The June assembly tree supplies the part relationships for that handoff. Credit: Locoroll supplier coordination. Later package checks still retained naming, mapping and revision work.

events.title: Foam alternatives studied for the return spring
events.summary: The study compares extra-soft slow-rebound PORON with soft and firm alternatives using supplier stock sizes and stress-strain curves. Credit: Locoroll study; Rogers material data.
events.date_basis: Deck title date and same-day catalog annotation metadata, not catalog effective date

events.title: A staged plan for the front housing
events.summary: Erik's proposed factory schedule follows the housing from casting through machining and finishing to inspection, comparing batch timing and the capacity of successive operations. Credit: Erik Norris; Best factory execution separate.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.; August29/August31 delivery and version labels. Printed July and September columns are schedule dates.

events.title: Later return-spring arrangements photographed
events.summary: The retained photograph shows later physical spring arrangements alongside the continuing base-station work. Credit: NOON project archive; design authorship not assigned by the image.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Reversed-polarity fault investigation
events.summary: Erik recalls a fuse failing violently in reversed-polarity installation tests, repeating in every trial of that series. He investigated effects and mitigations but reached no verified explanation or fix before the work stopped around the company's closure. Credit: Erik Norris, direct recollection.
events.date_basis: Direct operator recollection; calendar position unknown. No final explanation or fix verified.

events.title: Adjacent-pin short destroys a unit
events.summary: Erik identifies a separate failure in the retained C0002 video still: two adjacent pins shorted under certain conditions and killed the unit. The triggering conditions and any mitigation remain unspecified. Credit: Erik Norris, direct recollection.
events.date_basis: Operator recollection. Exact conditions and date not established; separate failure mode.

verification.scope: Nine unchanged v4 events plus two separately identified, explicitly undated recollections. No conflated cause, final fix, exact per-clip configuration or date inferred.
